description: Record whether an article answer actually worked in your environment: solved, partial or failed. Run the article verify command first; solved requires evidence.exit_code = 0. failed requires the exact solution id, revision, reason and your environment, and two independent failed reports mark that revision known_failed there. Two independent solved reports promote the answer to verified. This is the MCP equivalent of POST /v1/feedback.

exit_code.description: Exit code you observed; solved requires 0.

output_sha256.description: Optional sha256 of the captured output.

node_version.description: Pinned content hash, when you read a specific version.

solution.description: Solution id that was tried or verified.

name: report_feedback
